title: Borderlands 4

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Borderlands 4 as the archive’s contemporary Borderlands digital filing.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and 2K / Rockstar launcher services where the client requires them.
preservation.concerns: Account-bound digital holdings face platform dependency and launcher requirements. Online components increase long-term access risk. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam release dated September 11, 2025. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required services remain intact.
